## Developer Guide

If you are new to using `nbdev` here are some useful pointers to get you
started.

### Install generated_mne_for_eeg in Development mode

``` sh
# make sure generated_mne_for_eeg package is installed in development mode
$ pip install -e .

# make changes under nbs/ directory
# ...

# compile to have changes apply to generated_mne_for_eeg
$ nbdev_prepare
```

## Usage

### Installation

Install latest from the GitHub
[repository](https://github.com/bkowshik/generated-mne-for-eeg):

``` sh
$ pip install git+https://github.com/bkowshik/generated-mne-for-eeg.git
```

or from [conda](https://anaconda.org/bkowshik/generated-mne-for-eeg)

``` sh
$ conda install -c bkowshik generated_mne_for_eeg
```

or from [pypi](https://pypi.org/project/generated-mne-for-eeg/)

``` sh
$ pip install generated_mne_for_eeg
```
